file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) Windows console executable, MinGW-w64 / GCC 13 built (19 sections, DWARF debug info + COFF symbols retained)

injection_details.method: Classic Process Hollowing / RunPE (CreateProcessA CREATE_SUSPENDED -> NtUnmapViewOfSection -> VirtualAllocEx -> WriteProcessMemory -> GetThreadContext/SetThreadContext (RCX) -> ResumeThread)
injection_details.target_discovery: Hardcoded absolute path built on the stack at runtime with 64-bit movabs immediates ('C:\Windo' + 'ws\Syste' + 'm32\svch' + 'ost.exe\0') into a 260-byte (MAX_PATH) buffer that is then zero-filled with rep stosq; no process enumeration - the victim process is created by the malware itself in a suspended state
injection_details.step_1_create: CreateProcessA(NULL, targetPath, NULL, NULL, FALSE, dwCreationFlags=0x4 /*CREATE_SUSPENDED*/, NULL, NULL, &si(0x68 bytes), &pi(0x18 bytes))
injection_details.step_2_locate_image_base: NtQueryInformationProcess(hProcess, ProcessBasicInformation=0, &pbi, 0x30, &retLen) -> PebBaseAddress (pbi+0x8); then NtReadVirtualMemory(hProcess, PEB+0x10 /*ImageBaseAddress*/, &remoteImageBase, 8, &bytesRead)
injection_details.step_3_unmap: NtUnmapViewOfSection(hProcess, remoteImageBase) - dynamically resolved from ntdll.dll
injection_details.step_4_allocate: VirtualAllocEx(hProcess, remoteImageBase, payloadSize=0x40, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000), PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40)); on failure retries with lpAddress=NULL (relocation-agnostic fallback)
injection_details.step_5_write: WriteProcessMemory(hProcess, remoteBase, decryptedPayload, 0x40, &bytesWritten); on failure VirtualFreeEx(MEM_RELEASE) + TerminateProcess + CloseHandle
injection_details.step_7_execute: ResumeThread(hThread), then CloseHandle(hThread) and CloseHandle(hProcess); WinMain then Sleep(2000)
injection_details.payload: 64-byte (0x40) shellcode stub stored encrypted in .data at 0x140004000 (g_encrypted_pe_stub), decrypted in memory before injection
injection_details.error_handling: Every failure branch calls TerminateProcess(hProcess,0) + CloseHandle(hThread/hProcess) and returns -1, leaving no orphaned suspended process

encryption_details.algorithm: Two-layer: (1) repeating-key XOR, then (2) RC4 (standard 256-byte KSA + PRGA implemented inline as rc4_init @0x1400014ef / rc4_crypt @0x1400015e2)
encryption_details.key: XOR key (10 bytes) = DE AD BE EF 13 37 CA FE BA BE  |  RC4 key (16 bytes ASCII) = "Hollowing_PE!!!!"
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are hardcoded in plaintext in the .rdata section: g_xor_key at VA 0x140005000 (10 bytes, followed by 00 00 padding) and g_rc4_key at VA 0x140005010 (16 ASCII bytes). Ciphertext payload g_encrypted_pe_stub is 64 bytes in .data at VA 0x140004000. Decryption order in WinMain: xor_decrypt(buf,0x40,g_xor_key,10) then rc4_init(state,g_rc4_key,16)+rc4_crypt(state,buf,0x40)

decoded_strings.g_xor_key (.rdata 0x140005000): de ad be ef 13 37 ca fe ba be
decoded_strings.final payload (after RC4 with \"Hollowin: 64-byte binary shellcode stub written into the hollowed svchost.exe at its original ImageBase; not byte-decoded statically (requires executing RC4 KSA/PRGA), plaintext is non-ASCII machine code

anti_analysis: NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessInformationClass = 7 (ProcessDebugPort) on GetCurrentProcess(); treats a returned debug port of 0xFFFFFFFF as 'debugger present'
NtQueryInformationProcess with ProcessInformationClass = 0x1F (ProcessDebugFlags); a value of 0 indicates the process was created with DEBUG_PROCESS -> flagged as debugged
Anti-debug syscall wrapper is resolved dynamically at runtime (GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress) so no ntdll import appears in the import table
Graceful/silent bail-out: anti_analysis_check() returning 1 makes WinMain return 0 immediately, so no payload decryption or injection occurs and no crash/error is visible to the analyst
Sensitive API names and the payload are not present as plaintext strings; payload is double-encrypted (XOR then RC4) in .data to defeat static signature/YARA scanning
Injection target path is assembled from 64-bit immediate constants on the stack instead of being stored as a contiguous string
Runtime redirection of execution via SetThreadContext RCX instead of CreateRemoteThread/WriteProcessMemory-on-entrypoint, avoiding the most commonly hooked injection API
Benign-looking import set (only KERNEL32 + msvcrt, no ntdll/ws2_32) reduces static suspicion
